jobs.title: Research Associate for the Project "Climate, Climatic Change, and Society" (CLICCS) N4 – Scale interactions in a warming Arctic
jobs.reason: The essential profile requires a natural-science degree (climate science, geoecology, meteorology, etc.), knowledge of biogeochemical soil processes, greenhouse-gas flux measurement, eddy covariance methods, and MATLAB/Python scientific programming — all technical essentials the candidate's IR/law background cannot meet. Although this is a funded doctoral-track post, the field is entirely outside the candidate's expertise and interests.

jobs.title: Associate Communications and Social Media (gn) - Plattform #Staatsmodernisierung
jobs.reason: This is a communications-specialist role asking for at least two years of relevant communications experience plus specific tooling (Typo3, podcast production, graphic design in Canva) — a substantial partial skills gap for the candidate, whose comms/events experience is limited, though the two-year ask is not a hard disqualifier. German C2 is met, but the topic (government modernisation) sits outside the core interest zones, so interest pull is low. Eligible but a weak fit overall.

jobs.title: PhD Researchers/Research Associates (gn) - Public Administration Reform and Government Digitalization
jobs.reason: A funded PhD post with a Master's entry requirement — on-level and eligible, and German fluency (C1 required) is easily met by the native-speaker candidate. However, public administration reform / government digitalization sits outside the core interest zones, and the profile favours a public-administration/policy background with German public-sector experience, which the candidate does not have; the AI-in-government angle only lightly touches zone (c).
jobs.type: Part-time / Full-time (funded PhD, up to 3 years)

jobs.title: Fachbereichsleitung Internationales (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: This is a department-head ("Fachbereichsleitung") role explicitly requiring years of leadership experience, managing ~20 staff across three teams and serving as a foundation board member — far above entry-level and a hard disqualifier on seniority. The topic (international nature conservation) also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Head of Data Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: A "Head of" title signals a senior leadership role well beyond entry-level, and it is a deep-technical data-engineering position whose essential requirements far exceed the candidate's analysis-level Python. Both the seniority and the technical demands are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Student Assistant (gn) - Plattform #Staatsmodernisierung
jobs.reason: This is a student-assistant post explicitly requiring current enrolment, which is excluded as a student side-role by policy. It also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones, focusing on German government modernisation and public administration.

jobs.title: Student Research Assistant (gn) - Plattform #Staatsmodernisierung
jobs.reason: This is an explicitly student-assistant role requiring current enrolment in a public administration/management programme in the Berlin area, which is an excluded working-student category under policy. It also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones (German government modernisation/digital governance), so even setting aside the disqualifier it would be a weak fit.
